title: P1 interpolation activation wiring (draw_packets alpha branch + main.odin alpha computation) has no automated test
detail: Unit tests call packet_interp_pos directly; all goldens render alpha=1.0. A broken activation (wrong tick, alpha, or mode gate) passes every automated gate — the exact silent-break class the r1 field notes flag.
recommended_fix: Pin the activation: extract main.odin's alpha computation into a testable helper, and add a headless (rlsw) render test driving draw_packets at alpha=0.5.

title: Evidence tooling (motion-strip verb, measure_packet_motion.py) hardened by review but untested
detail: P3 dev tooling: the r1 review guards (export abort, frames==0, arg validation, frame-name mismatch) are code-only. A regression silently corrupts the rule-4 displacement evidence, not shipped behavior.
recommended_fix: Add CLI smoke tests: bad args and mismatched strip dirs exit 2; a small python unit test for measure_packet_motion's table and guards.
